newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Land rises on Parkway deal.
newsitem.headline: DBS Land rises on Parkway deal.

text.p: DBS Land Ltd shares rose on news that it was buying a 19.16 percent stake in property and healthcare group Parkway Holdings, dealers said on Wednesday.
At 0756 GMT, the shares were up 12 cents to Singapore $4.96. Volume was about 1.5 million units.
"It looks like the market likes the deal and the company has said it wanted to move into health care," said an institutional dealer with a local bank.
DBS Land announced on Tuesday it would pay S$391 million, or S$6.50 a share, to Malaysia's Hospital Pantai for a 19.2 percent stake in Parkway.
"The price looks expensive. But it looks like DBS will be going in for the long haul so it wouldn't mind paying a premium," an analyst with a British broking firm said.
She said for health care to become a core business for DBS Land, it would have to take a larger stake in Parkway. "It would be a very costly exercise but I would not rule it out."
Parkway shares were also up 10 cents to S$6.55 with about half a million shares traded.
